create_PCAVisualizer: create a PCAVisualizer to reduce high-dimensional feature vectors to 3 PCA components for visualization
run_PCAVisualizer_call: run a PCAVisualizer instance on new feature data to transform and normalize the output
build_normalize_function: build a normalize function that divides input arrays by their L2 norm along the last axis
test_PCAVisualizer_with_sigmoid: test a PCAVisualizer configured with sigmoid activation and whitening on feature data
review_PCAVisualizer_init: review the PCAVisualizer __init__ method that fits PCA on a random sample of input features
